title: Rescaled Artinian coefficient algebra before zero padding and ideal bounds

from.place: Lemma 07FJ, steps 10--13 and 15 construct the unpadded rescaled parameters and coefficients; step 25 forms the polynomial coefficient algebra, before the powered-ideal comparison of step 23

proof_origin.place: Lemma 07FJ, steps 10--13 and 15 via rescaling data, followed by the polynomial coefficient base change of step 25

statement:
Let k:Type u be a field of characteristic p>0, A:Type v a finitely presented commutative k-algebra, Λ:Type w a Noetherian geometrically regular k-algebra, α:A→ₐ[k]Λ, and q∈Spec Λ. Put L=Λ_q. Let N>0 with m_L^N contained in the extension to L of α(singularIdeal k A), d=spanFinrank(m_L), a:Fin s→A generating singularIdeal k A, c>0, and n₀=N+d(8c). Fix a surjective polynomial presentation f:k[z_i:i∈Fin r]→A. Fix φ₀:k[y_i:i∈Fin m₀]→Λ and its localized map ψ₀:P₀=(k[y_i])_(φ₀⁻¹q)→L, commuting with the polynomial map. Suppose ψ₀ is flat and the contracted prime extends to m_L. Fix a local Artinian ring D₀:Type(max u w), with a local essentially smooth algebra structure over P₀/(φ₀⁻¹q P₀)^n₀ and a flat local homomorphism g₀:D₀→L/m_L^n₀, such that the quotient diagram commutes and each α(f(z_i)) modulo m_L^n₀ is in the range of g₀. All notions are those of the statement-dependency nodes.
There exist m, compatible k-algebra structures S=k[X_i:i∈Fin d]→R=k[Y_i:i∈Fin m]→Λ, ell:Fin d×Fin s→Λ and rho:Fin d→R, with rho_i=image(X_i), image(X_i)^(2N)=Σ_j ell(i,j)α(a_j), image(rho_i)∈q, and equal kernels for multiplication by rho_i and rho_i² on R and on Λ modulo the preceding (8c)-th powers, indexed by Fin d. Set Q=R_(q∩R) and K=m_L^n₀. There is an ideal H⊂R with HQ=(image(rho_i):i∈Fin d) and HL=m_L. Set I₀=H^n₀. There is a local Artinian k-algebra D′:Type(max u v). For E=D′[T_i:i∈Fin d], there are compatible R,R/I₀,S,k algebra structures, E essentially smooth over R/I₀ and a scalar tower k→D′→E. There are f₀:A→ₐ[k]D′, g:D′→L/K flat and local, unscaled coefficients u₀:Fin d→D′, units δ:Fin d→D′ˣ and coeff:Fin d×Fin s→D′. The ring L/K is local; the S-map sends X_i to C(u₀(i))T_i; evaluation eval₂Hom(g,i↦g(δ_i)) after the R-structure map equals R→Λ→L→L/K; g∘f₀ equals α modulo K, and g(coeff(i,j)) equals ell(i,j) modulo K. This statement does not append zero, choose a powered parameter ideal J, or assert any containment involving J.

proof.text: Apply the rescaling-data construction, retaining all parameter equations, kernel identities, H and its localization equalities, the coefficient quotient B, D′ essentially smooth over B, the polynomial quotient equivalence e:R/H^n≃ₐ[k]B[T_i], and the coefficient-map and evaluation identities. No polynomial coefficient-algebra structure is supplied by this result.

Set E=D′[T_i]. Define θ:R/H^n→ₐ[k]E as coefficient mapping after e, and χ:R→ₐ[k]E by composition with the quotient homomorphism. Define the S-algebra structure by χ after S→R. The definitions give the R→R/H^n→E and S→R→E scalar towers; k-linearity gives k→S→E, and the canonical polynomial structure gives k→D′→E.

Base change the essentially smooth B-algebra D′ along B→B[T_i]. Tensor commutativity followed by MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv identifies B[T_i]⊗_B D′ with E as B[T_i]-algebras: on q⊗1 the image is coefficientMap(q). Transport the smooth localization presentation along this equivalence. Restrict along e:R/H^n≃B[T_i]; the equivalence is smooth and composing its map with the smooth presentation gives essential smoothness of E over R/H^n. This restriction is proved directly on localization presentations, so no essentially-smooth-composition theorem is needed here.

Unfold θ, χ and the S-structure on E. The polynomial coefficient identity is exactly the S-generator formula, and the retained evaluation identity is exactly the structural R-map identity. Keep the A-map, coefficient lifts, flatness, localness, and the original existential witnesses. All constructions apply to d=0 without a special branch.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_unpadded_coefficient_chart
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).spanFinrank)
    (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (r : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin r) k →ₐ[k] A) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (m₀ : ℕ) (φ₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    (ψ₀ : Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) →+*
      Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
    (hψ₀ : ψ₀.comp (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom))) =
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom)
    (hideal₀ : q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom))
    (hflat₀ : ψ₀.Flat)
    (D₀ : Type (max u w)) [CommRing D₀] [IsLocalRing D₀] [IsArtinianRing D₀]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^ (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀]
    (g₀ : D₀ →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      (q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)]
    [IsLocalHom g₀]
    (hsmooth₀ : EssentiallySmooth
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)
    (hgflat₀ : g₀.Flat)
    (hfactor₀ : (g₀.comp (algebraMap
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)).comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c)))) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.asIdeal.map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c)))).comp ψ₀)
    (hinc₀ : ∀ i : Fin r, Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (α (f (MvPolynomial.X i)))) ∈
        Set.range g₀) :
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : Algebra S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : Algebra S Λ) (_ : IsScalarTower S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S Λ) (ell : Fin d × Fin s → Λ)
      (rho : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
    (rho = fun i ↦ algebraMap S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)) ∧
    (∀ i, algebraMap S Λ (MvPolynomial.X i) ^ (2 * N) =
      ∑ j : Fin s, ell (i, j) * α (a j)) ∧
    (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (rho i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin d)
      (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
        {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧ y = rho j ^ (c * 8)}),
      rho i • x = 0 ↔ rho i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin d)
      (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
        {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧
            y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (rho j) ^ (c * 8)}),
      rho i • x = 0 ↔ rho i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    let K := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
    ∃ (H : Ideal R),
      H.map (algebraMap R Q) =
        Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦ algebraMap R Q (rho i))) ∧
      H.map ((algebraMap Λ L).comp (algebraMap R Λ)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ∧
      ∃ (D' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D')
        (_ : IsLocalRing D') (_ : IsArtinianRing D') (_ : Algebra k D'),
        let I₀ := H ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
        let E := MvPolynomial (Fin d) D'
        ∃ (_ : Algebra R E) (_ : Algebra (R ⧸ I₀) E)
          (_ : IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ I₀) E)
          (algSE : Algebra S E) (_ : IsScalarTower S R E)
          (_ : Algebra k E) (_ : IsScalarTower k S E),
          EssentiallySmooth (R ⧸ I₀) E ∧
          ∃ (_ : IsScalarTower k D' E)
            (f₀ : A →ₐ[k] D') (g : D' →+* L ⧸ K)
            (u₀ : Fin d → D') (δ : Fin d → D'ˣ) (coeff : Fin d × Fin s → D'),
            IsLocalRing (L ⧸ K) ∧ IsLocalHom g ∧ g.Flat ∧
            (∀ i : Fin d, @algebraMap S E _ _ algSE (MvPolynomial.X (R := k) i) =
              MvPolynomial.C (σ := Fin d) (u₀ i) * MvPolynomial.X (R := D') i) ∧
            (∀ z : R, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom g (fun i ↦ g (δ i : D'))
              (algebraMap R E z) =
              Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (algebraMap R Λ z))) ∧
            (∀ x, g (f₀ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (α x))) ∧
            (∀ ij, g (coeff ij) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (ell ij)))
